takeaway: Book key: polyvinyl chloride. HCC mostly follows hepatitis B or C or cirrhosis; other causes include alcohol, aflatoxin, iron overload, NASH and type 2 diabetes.

lines.text: Which carcinogen is linked to hepatocellular carcinoma?
Hepatocellular carcinoma is the most common type of liver cancer.
Most cases follow viral hepatitis, B or C, or cirrhosis, most often from alcohol.
Other known causes include toxins such as alcohol, aflatoxin and iron overload,
and metabolic disease: non-alcoholic steatohepatitis and type 2 diabetes.
lines.say: and metabolic disease: non-alcoholic steatohepatitis and type two diabetes.

lines.text: Among the options given, the book's answer is polyvinyl chloride.
So remember: polyvinyl chloride, linked to hepatocellular carcinoma.
